name: bugport
description: BugPort — Reproduce a production bug locally in under 90 seconds. Captures a sanitised production snapshot (DB state + request context), checks PII safety via Laya AI, then writes a minimal reproduction harness that engineers can run locally.

bug_description.description: Description of the bug to reproduce (e.g. 'Race condition in inventory reservation causing negative stock').

snapshot_json.description: Production DB/state snapshot as a JSON string. PII fields are auto-detected and masked by Laya AI before the harness is written.

demo.description: Run with pre-recorded demo data (race condition in inventory reservation).

harness_path.description: Path to the generated reproduction harness file.

pii_fields_masked.description: List of snapshot fields that were masked due to PII detection.

reproduction_confidence.description: Laya noul confidence (0.0-1.0) that the harness will reproduce the bug.

laya_decision.question: Does this snapshot field contain personal user data?

examples.title: Demo run (inventory race condition)
examples.description: Captures a production snapshot of the inventory service, masks PII, reproduces a race condition locally with 86% Laya confidence.
